question:
**Select the most appropriate word that means the same as the group of words given.**

Hard and difficult to bend
solution: The correct answer is "**Rigid**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the given words. • **Pliable: **easily bent; flexible. • **Rigid: **unable to bend or be forced out of shape; not flexible. • **Strong: **having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks. • **Flexible: **capable of bending easily without breaking. • As per the meaning of the given words, "**rigid**" is the word that means the same as the given group of words. • **Example**: *Rakesh had a **rigid**__** **mindset when it came to homosexuality.* • The correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of the given words. • **Pliable: ** आसानी से मुड़ा हुआ; लचीला। • **Rigid: ** झुकने या आकार से बाहर होने में असमर्थ; लचीला नहीं। • **Strong: ** भारी वजन उठाने या अन्य शारीरिक रूप से मांगलिक कार्यों को करने की शक्ति होना। • **Flexible: ** बिना टूटे आसानी से झुकने में सक्षम। • As per the meaning of the given words, "**rigid**" is the word that means the same as the given group of words. 38:T10d4, The correct answer is "**Busy**"
